Download the LZMA SDK from https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html
Extract the archive and copy all files from its C\ subfolder into this directory.

You should end up with files including:
  7z.h
  7zAlloc.c / 7zAlloc.h
  7zBuf.c / 7zBuf.h
  7zCrc.c / 7zCrc.h
  7zCrcOpt.c
  7zDec.c
  7zFile.c / 7zFile.h
  7zStream.c
  Bcj2.c / Bcj2.h
  Bra.c / Bra.h
  Bra86.c
  BraIA64.c
  CpuArch.c / CpuArch.h
  Delta.c / Delta.h
  Lzma2Dec.c / Lzma2Dec.h
  LzmaDec.c / LzmaDec.h
  Ppmd7.c / Ppmd7.h
  Ppmd7Dec.c
  ... and others
